remarks: Bright and Spacious Traditional Colonial on High Ridge. 4 generous size bedrooms, 2 Full bathrooms, hardwood floor throughout. Huge Living room ready to enjoy big family gatherings, enormous living room with fire place leading out to a heated sunroom with access to the patio, In-in kitchen with a breakfast bar ideal for a coffee morning completes the first floor. Attached garage, walk-out attic and a full basement. Great location close to public transportation, restaurants, school, parks and shopping. Easy access to Merritt Parkway and I-95 PLUS 45 mins drive to NY City!
